fusions.name: Torpor Spit
fusions.desc: Spits a cold ping into the first enemy it meets, dealing 7 frost damage with a 50% chance to leave it [Stalled] for 6 seconds. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Gloaming Wave
fusions.desc: A wave of cold deals 26 frost damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, ignoring their resistances, and leaves each [Exposed] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Dead Still
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds: enemies notice you 50% later, you move 10% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Warm Rest
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you recover 4 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 20 seconds.
